content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Devon: finally aired the kitchen out, still faint smoke tho
Me: lol did the sweatshirt survive
Devon: febrezed it twice, still smells like campfire
Me: toss it in the wash tomorrow
Devon: yeah doing laundry tomorrow anyway, out of clean socks again
Me: thought you had growth last time
Devon: growth expired
Me: same, cat is parked on the clean load again
Devon: of course, tradition never dies
Me: literally only sits on clean, never dirty
Devon: zero chill forever
Me: what did you end up having for dinner
Devon: just did toast again, peanut butter era continues
Me: elite fallback tho
Devon: fr, you eat yet
Me: heating up that tomato soup from last week
Devon: oh the one you said you needed to finish
Me: yep before it goes bad
Devon: 5th was still a mess on the way home?
Me: yep by the bank again, cones everywhere
Devon: those things are permanent at this point
Me: should've taken oak but was too lazy to reroute
Devon: same, i cut through by the office and it wasn't better
Me: mom still have that leftover potato salad
Devon: yeah she asked if you were stopping by tomorrow after noon
Me: probably, tell her i said hi
Devon: will do, she'll make extra if you're coming
Me: no self control with that stuff
Devon: like us with garlic knots
Me: did yours even make it home back then
Devon: absolutely not, ate em in the car
Me: same lol
Devon: hey wanna do pizza friday after work
Me: this friday?
Devon: yeah, was thinking rosa's again on oak
Me: ah i can't this friday, got stuck covering till late
Devon: ugh your boss again?
Me: yep asked last minute and i couldn't say no this time
Devon: that sucks, you work too many late nights already
Me: fr, what about next friday instead
Devon: like not this coming friday but the one after?
Me: yeah friday next week, i'm free then
Devon: oh yeah that works better for me too actually
Me: cool, still wanna do pizza then?
Devon: definitely, where you thinking
Me: what about luigi's on 5th street, been forever since we went
Devon: ohh garlic knots, i'm in
Me: parking in back like last time is easier
Devon: yeah back lot, traffic on 5th is still dumb but whatever
Me: leave a little early and it's fine
Devon: is 6 pm good for you that day?
Me: yeah that works
Devon: perfect, i can leave on time that day, no chart hell
Me: nice, i'll head straight from the office too
Devon: i'll grab us a table if i get there first
Me: sounds good, i'll text when i'm parking
Devon: mom will be jealous, she still talks about you demolishing that salad
Me: tell her i'll save room for next lunch after noon-ish
Devon: lol she'll hold you to that
Me: okay soup is boiling over gotta go
Devon: go save dinner lol
Me: talk tomorrow?
Devon: yep, enjoy the soup not-toast era",
  "writer_note": "Kept the Monday-evening voice with cats, laundry, toast era and potato salad chatter, then used a this-Friday conflict to shift the plan to Friday next week and lock in Luigi's on 5th Street at 6pm with a short acceptance."
}
